footer.copy: UX Content Collective · Technical Content Designer Program · October 2026

dashboard.heading: Welcome to the program
dashboard.subheading: Review your content system, evaluate copy against your rules, and follow the weekly exercises.
dashboard.contentlabDesc: View your content files as formatted pages, or an example. Edit and save your files locally to update.
dashboard.playgroundDesc: Check copy against your eval criteria and view results. Edit and save your evals locally to update.
dashboard.exercisesDesc: Follow each week's task, with prep work, learning objectives, and hints.
dashboard.resourcesDesc: Find setup instructions, key terms, repo guidance, AI tooling, and review checklists.

contentlab.heading: ContentLab
contentlab.subheading: Read the content files you edit in your coding environment. Save a file to update this view.
contentlab.exampleSubheading: A finished content system for Luma, a fictional team workflow app. Read it to see what done looks like, then write your own.
contentlab.emptyTitle: Select a file to view it.

playground.promptDescription: Select files to inspect their combined text and estimated token count. Your coding assistant can read these files directly; you do not need to copy this text to complete the exercise.
playground.emptyPrompt: Select at least one file to build a prompt.
playground.evalDescription: View the evaluation rules you define in content/evals.json. Edit that file in your coding environment and save to update this view.
playground.samplesDescription: These are the sample strings in content/evals.json, checked against your criteria. Expand a test case to inspect its results.
playground.noCriteria: No criteria yet. Add some to content/evals.json.
playground.noApplicableCriteria: No criteria apply to this component. Add a matching rule in content/evals.json.
playground.noSamples: No samples yet. Ask your coding assistant to help add copy to content/evals.json, then review and save the file.
playground.expectedFailHelp: This sample should fail at least one check. If every check passes, the test needs attention.
playground.expectedPassHelp: This sample should pass every applicable check.
playground.reviewHelp: These checks cover only the rules in content/evals.json. Review voice, meaning, and accessibility yourself. Revise copy in your coding environment, save it, and check again.
playground.rulesDescription: These criteria come from content/evals.json. Each card explains the check and where it applies. Replace the starter criteria with rules for your product.
playground.mustMatchHelp: Checks that the copy includes the required wording or text pattern.
playground.mustNotMatchHelp: Checks that the copy avoids the wording or text pattern defined in this rule.
playground.maxCharsHelp: Allows up to {value} characters, including spaces and punctuation.
playground.bannedWordsHelp: Checks that none of the listed words appear as whole words, regardless of capitalization.
playground.sentenceCaseHelp: Checks for capitalized words after the first word. Allows acronyms, sentence starts, the word I, and any names listed as exceptions.
playground.unknownRuleHelp: This check type is not supported. Review its definition in content/evals.json.
